scope: Owned synthetic test applications, supported native controls, explicitly approved alternative target names. No claim of arbitrary production mutation safety or hostile-page containment.

checks.criterion: Two structurally different applications use the same generic adapter
checks.evidence: Registration and contact real-browser cases call runGenericScenario; adapter contains no app-specific selector branches.

checks.criterion: Stagehand discovers unfamiliar controls without fixture-specific selectors
checks.evidence: Live observation produced xpath=/html[1]/body[1]/section[1]/article[1]/form[1]/footer[1]/button[1]; no selector supplied for the adapted button.

checks.criterion: Safe operational UI changes can be handled and recorded
checks.evidence: Submit to explicitly approved Send Message: live adaptation metadata, DOM verification and linked PNG evidence.

Owned capability, explicit authorization, prepared origin/environment/revision and one-use expiry enforced. Unauthorized and forged requests rejected. Applies to the enabled owned synthetic environment, not arbitrary hostile websites.

checks.criterion: Actual browser assertions determine PASS or FAIL
checks.evidence: DOM/URL/enabled/visibility measurements and bounded polling; model opinions cannot set assertion verdicts.

checks.criterion: A deliberate product failure remains FAIL with evidence
checks.evidence: Injected wrong contact confirmation: expected Message received, actual Delivery failed. Ticket FAIL and screenshot survive SQLite restart.

checks.criterion: Unsupported steps and missing provider states are reported accurately
checks.evidence: Unknown operations blocked before execution; missing provider blocks required adaptation; browser failures inconclusive; remaining steps not run.

checks.criterion: Approved plan revision and original expectations remain immutable
checks.evidence: Entire saved snapshot compared before/after execution and database restart; stale/tampered revisions rejected; approved business expectation unchanged in product-defect case.

checks.criterion: Screenshots, adaptation history and consolidated reports are retained
checks.evidence: Adaptation report, revision/hash, criteria and PNG evidence verified after SQLite restart; Electron report/screenshot reload passes.

checks.criterion: Previous desktop tests pass and a live Stagehand run is demonstrated
checks.evidence: 44 browser/Electron tests, 83 desktop unit tests, 76 root tests and both typechecks pass. Separate live model receipt: PASS, one generation, one adaptation.

recommendation: Ready for final M5 approval within the stated owned-test scope. No additional milestone started.
